payload.headline: Kolkata's sewage-treatment promises
payload.intro: Dated commitments from KMC's own statutory filings and from the ADB-disclosed KMC-SHARP programme. The two KEIIP-era plants in the 2021 Environment Plan were re-dated to 31 March 2026 in KMC's February 2026 due diligence reports, which carry them into KMC-SHARP as spill-over packages; that date has passed, and we have not found a commissioning record for either. The KMC-SHARP packages have named contractors, contractual completion dates and a percentage-progress figure refreshed every six months by an ADB disclosure obligation rather than at the implementing agency's discretion. Five of them commenced on 15 October 2025 and every one stood at 0.0% physical progress on 31 December 2025 - a baseline the next report either moves or does not.

status_legend.delivered: Done, with a source confirming it
status_legend.slipped: Officially or credibly re-dated - both dates kept
status_legend.overdue: Past its promised date with no official word
status_legend.unverified: We can cite the promise but cannot yet cite its current status either way.

commitments.title: Commission the 45 MLD STP at Near WBSETCL, Joka
commitments.what: KMC's District Environment Plan 2021 records this plant at 17% completion with a stated timeline of March, 2022 - a deadline already less than four months away when the plan was filed on 1 December 2021. KMC's February 2026 due diligence report, which carries the plant into KMC-SHARP as spill-over package SD28, gives an expected completion date of 31.03.2026; we have not found a completion record.

commitment_source.label: Kolkata Municipal Corporation, District Environment Plan 2021 - Kolkata, p.29

status_history.note: 17% complete against a March, 2022 timeline
status_history.source_label: District Environment Plan 2021 - Kolkata

status_history.note: Deadline is four years past. No KEIIP or KMC document confirming commissioning, slippage or a revised date has been located, so the status cannot move to delivered or overdue without inventing evidence.

Checked 18 October 2026. KMC's February 2026 safeguards due diligence report for package KEIIP/NCB/TR-3/SD28/2017-18, now a spill-over package under KMC-SHARP, gives a scheduled date of completion of 02.09.2021 and an actual / expected date of completion of 31.03.2026, with the spill-over works '62.26% completed for civil work'. The KEIIP Tranche 3 monitoring report for June to November 2025 records 68.45% physical progress as on 30 November 2025. The 31.03.2026 date has passed and we have not found a completion record.
status_history.source_label: Kolkata Municipal Corporation for ADB, Safeguards Due Diligence Report: STP near WBSETCL, Joka (spill-over package SD28), February 2026

commitments.title: Commission the 41 MLD STP at Anandapur, Ward 108
commitments.committed_by: Kolkata Municipal Corporation / KMC SHARP, financed by the Asian Development Bank
commitments.what: KMC's 2021 Environment Plan listed a 70 MLD plant for Borough-XII with no timeline, to be built 'based on implementation of future loan or from own resources'. The loan arrived: this is now a 41 MLD Sequencing batch reactor (SBR) plant under KMC SHARP (ADB project 56287-001), package KMC SHARP/OCB/SD 04/2025-26, with bids invited march 2026; 3.5-year design-and-construction period, then 15 years o&m. Originally sited at Hossainpur in the SAME ward under the same package, with a draft IEE disclosed via ADB in 2024. Relocated after legal litigation made that land parcel unavailable; the new site is within 2.5 km. It is being built on KMDA-owned, currently a non-operational oxidation pond, discharging to Lead Channel D-D1, to NGT effluent standards.

commitment_source.label: KMC/ADB, Updated Initial Environmental Examination, 24 Feb 2026

status_history.note: Listed at 70 MLD for Borough-XII with no timeline and no committed funding
status_history.source_label: District Environment Plan 2021 - Kolkata

status_history.note: Financed and scheduled: 41 MLD at Anandapur, bids March 2026, 3.5-year build. Capacity is 41 MLD, not the 70 MLD proposed in 2021, and the site moved after litigation.
status_history.source_label: KMC/ADB, Updated Initial Environmental Examination, 24 Feb 2026

status_history.note: Checked 18 October 2026. KMC issued the invitation for bids for KMC-SHARP/OCB/SD04/2025-26, 'Design & Construction of 41 MLD Sewage Treatment Plant at Anandapur in Ward 108', dated 03.03.2026, with a bid deadline of 23.04.2026. The February 2026 IEE said the project 'is likely to be awarded by September 2026'. We have not found a contract award or a progress figure for the work, so the status moves from on-track to unverified until one is published.
status_history.source_label: KMC-SHARP, Invitation for Bids, Contract Package KMC-SHARP/OCB/SD04/2025-26, 3 March 2026

commitments.committed_by: Kolkata Municipal Corporation, KMC-SHARP programme, financed by the Asian Development Bank (Loan 4584-IND)
commitments.what: 8.4 km combined RCC sewer network, 981 catch pits, 52 gully pits, 466 manholes, house service connections, and five gravity outfalls discharging storm-water flow into the Guniagachi canal in the Tollygunge-Panchanangram basin. Letter of award 28.04.2025, contract awarded 30.06.2025, notice to proceed 24.09.2025, work formally commenced 15.10.2025. Contractor: M/s Traders & Engineers Private Ltd.. As of 2025-12-31 the package stood at 0.0% physical progress, with topographical survey and manhole-data collection under way.

status_history.note: Checked 18 October 2026. KMC's updated IEE for packages SD01 and SD02 (April 2026) reports that 'work mainly survey and detailed design was commenced on October 2025 and work presently under progress at priority zones'. It gives no percentage figure, and we have not found a semi-annual environment monitoring report for January to June 2026 on the KMC-SHARP reports page, so the latest dated figure is 0.0% physical progress on 31 December 2025. payload.update_model: Statuses change only with a dated citation; every change appends to the commitment's history, and the slippage trail is the product. Kolkata's verification calendar is now real: KMC-SHARP publishes a Semi Annual Environment Monitoring Report through ADB, so these packages have a fixed six-monthly checkpoint. The two 2021 KEIIP-era plants now carry dates from KMC's February 2026 due diligence reports, which bring them into KMC-SHARP as spill-over packages.
